questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding the 19th Asian Games, held in Hangzhou, China (2023): I. The official mascot for the Games was 'Bing Dwen Dwen'. II. India achieved its best-ever medal tally at these Games. III. India won over 100 medals for the first time in the history of the Asian Games. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

options.explanation: Statement I is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect.
Statements II and III are correct.
Statement I is incorrect.

questions.explanation: Statement I is incorrect; 'Bing Dwen Dwen' was the mascot for the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics.
